sections.title: 1. About you
sections.purpose: Who is applying. Name split into first/last; CNIC is the duplicate check.

sections.title: 2. Contact
sections.purpose: One mobile number, one email (both validated; email unique).

sections.title: 3. Family & income
sections.purpose: Parents' occupation and income (category + number) for need assessment.

sections.title: 4. Church
sections.purpose: Church / worship place and pastor or priest (for the recommendation letter).

sections.title: 5. What you are studying now
sections.purpose: Level -> institution -> programme (typeaheads), start and end term, current semester/year.

sections.title: 6. University results (one entry per term)
sections.purpose: Shown only if you have finished at least one term. Each entry is tied to a real term, never "Semester 1".

sections.title: 7. Earlier education
sections.purpose: Matric / O-Level and Intermediate / A-Level (plus any earlier degree). Results go here, not in Section 6.

sections.title: 8. Fees & other scholarships
sections.purpose: Fee for the term you are applying for, and other support.

sections.title: 10. References & how you heard about RAPID
sections.purpose: One faculty reference and one family reference.

sections.title: 11. Documents
sections.purpose: One upload slot per document type; files are renamed automatically. Result documents are uploaded inside Sections 6 and 7.

fields.label: [system] Needs review
fields.validation: true if any *Other field is filled; lists the keys
fields.help: Drives the admin "Other" queue.

otherRule: Every list-backed select/typeahead (except Yes/No) has an "other" item. Choosing it shows <key>Other (text). On submit, each filled *Other value is written to otherSubmissions/{autoId} {field, rawValue, applicationId, status:"pending"} and the application gets needsReview=true.
